name: faq
description: Questions with expandable answers, plus FAQ schema

variants.list: One column of questions at full measure
variants.columns: Two columns of short questions; one on phones

modifiers.single: Opening one answer closes the others
modifiers.reveal: Rises into view once when scrolled to

sub.description: Line of text under the heading

schema.description: Emit FAQPage structured data (on by default)

valueDescriptions.on: Emit FAQPage JSON-LD for search engines
valueDescriptions.off: No structured data (use for a second FAQ)

text.description: The answer, shown when the question is open

more.description: Inline link to read more beyond the answer

item.description: One question; its label is the question text

checks.message: no questions declared — add: item "How long does it take?"
'{label}' is declared twice — the two anchors would collide, rename one
two FAQPage blocks on one page is invalid structured data — add 'schema off' to the second
{n} questions is a paragraph, not an FAQ — write it as 'text' or add more
{n} questions is a help centre — group them or move to a content system
"{label}" is not a question — phrase it the way a visitor would ask it
